evals.prompt: I need to add a new 'Workflow' metadata type to the console admin panel. It should be reachable from the admin navigation, list items with name/status/trigger-object columns, and ask for name plus trigger object when creating one.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the metadata-admin engine already delivers list/create/edit/history once the type exists in the framework's spec and type registry, so the UI-side work is an optional registerMetadataResource() override supplying listColumns and createFields. Points at packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/registry.ts, and reaches the surface through the app's navigation rather than a bespoke card or page.

evals.prompt: I want to create a custom detail page for the 'workflow' metadata type that has tabs for Settings, Steps, and History, similar to how object detail pages work.
evals.expected_output: Provides a PageSchema factory, self-contained widget components for each tab registered in ComponentRegistry, and an EditPage component that renders the factory's schema through SchemaRenderer — wired to the type by registerMetadataResource({ type: 'workflow', EditPage }). Notes that the console carries no schema-factory specimen today (the object-detail factory was retired in objectui#3731 / #3736) and that the live bespoke editor to copy is PermissionMatrixEditPage in packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx.

evals.prompt: The sidebar shows wrong navigation items when I navigate from the home page to an app page. How does the console navigation context work?
evals.expected_output: Explains NavigationContext (home vs app), how ConsoleLayout and HomeLayout set context, and how UnifiedSidebar renders different items based on context.
